title: node_chats Two Nullable Typed FKs With Exactly-One-Non-Null Check
description: The agent module shall enforce referential integrity on node_chats with exactly one owner FK non-null per row.
rationale: A polymorphic single node_id column with no FK produces orphan rows on node deletion because PostgreSQL cannot enforce a FK to two tables simultaneously. Two nullable typed FKs each with ON DELETE CASCADE give full referential integrity for both student and admin paths.
